pack.description: Custom resource pack with Fusion overrides

description:
The resource pack is titled “Custom resource pack with Fusion overrides” and is built for pack format 12, matching the current Minecraft version requirements.

Fusion support is enabled by placing override files in the **custom_fusion** folder. The pack uses two filter patterns: for standard Minecraft resources it limits the namespace to the regex `^minecraft$` and includes any JSON file under the assets directory with the path pattern `^assets/.*\.json$`; for texture files the namespace is unrestricted (`^.*$`) and it selects all PNG files in any textures sub‑directory using the path pattern `^textures/.*\.png$`.
